programme.title: The Book of Life
programme.desc: Two powerful magicians bet whether people are pure in heart.La Muerte is the ruler of the World of the Remembered.The dead stay there, remaining in the hearts of their loved ones.Xibalba rules the Land of the Forgotten - a sad place for souls that no one remembers.The magicians are tested by: fashion matador Manolo, who dreams of being a musician, and Joaquin - an athlete and the pride of the city.The boys compete for the affections of Maria, the daughter of the local mayor.However, the beautiful bride is resistant to their advances.Manolo and Joaquin will go on a wonderful journey, during which they will visit extraordinary lands, meet colorful characters and discover the truth about themselves.The project by Guillermo del Toro and Jorge R. Gutierrez was nominated for a Golden Globe in the category of best animated film.

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Nicky Spurgeon is a calculating fraud.The model's appearance and ability to keep cool make him a master criminal.He is able to win people over, but he does it to take advantage of them.One day, in a restaurant, he meets a fair-haired beauty, Jess Barrett, whose ambition is to pursue a criminal career.He becomes her mentor.Over time, they both realize that they have much more in common than the relationship of master and disciple.However, they live in a world where there is no place for love.Spurgeon ends this relationship.Three years pass.Nicky is in Buenos Aires, where he works for the owner of a car racing team, Rafael Garrigi.He meets his former lover here.Aware of her strengths, the femme fatale has one goal - to take revenge for the way she was once treated.

programme.title: Olivia and the Invisible Earthquake
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Olivia, together with her younger brother Tim and her mother, must suddenly leave their current apartment and start all over again in a strange neighborhood.Wanting to protect Tim from fear and alleviate his sense of loss, the girl tells him that their move is part of the film in which he is the main character.This challenge to their imagination helps them come to terms with difficult reality.Over time, through new friendships, fun, and even a bit of magic, the siblings discover that they can truly take responsibility for their story.

programme.title: The Munsters
programme.desc: Transylvania.Dr. Henry Augustus Wolfgang (Richard Brake) and his not very bright assistant Floop (Jorge Garcia) want to create the perfect man from the dead bodies of geniuses of the past century.By mistake, instead of the brain of a great scientist, they implant the organ of his twin brother, a bad comedian, into the creature they created.This is how Herman Potwornicki (Jeff Daniel Phillips) is created.When Wolfgang decides to show it to the world on TV, he is devastated.However, the uncouth, joking giant attracts the attention of the unmarried and undead Lily (Sheri Moon), who is fed up with unsuccessful dates.The girl finds Herman and they quickly become a couple.The future son-in-law, although he gained fame and won Lily's heart, does not like her father, a vampire and a refined count (Daniel Roebuck).However, the lovers get married.Due to the intrigues of the count's cunning ex-wife, Zoya Krupp (Catherine Schell) and her assistant, the werewolf Lester (Tomas Boykin), they lose their palace and fortune.They decide to go to America, where Herman intends to conquer Hollywood.They start a new life in a ruined house in the suburbs.A colorful production referring to the series from the 1960s. Director Rob Zombie is his big fan.

programme.title: Bambi: A Tale Of Life In The Woods
programme.desc: Bambi the deer runs away from hunters and gets lost in the forest.The terrified toddler is found by a majestic deer - his father.Gradually, Bambi must grow up and learn the art of survival.

programme.title: Wunderschöner
programme.desc: 50-year-old Nadine (Anneke Kim Sarnau) does everything to look young.When she discovers that her husband (Godehard Giese) is cheating on her, she falls into depression.The couple's daughter Lilly (Emilia Packard) is interested in the classes lectured by feminist Vicky (Nora Tschirner).Enno, the narrator's boyfriend, participates in the project of her new colleague Trevor (Malick Bauer).He doesn't know that his beloved will soon lose her head for him.Julie (Emilia Schüle), a new TV production manager, suffers from loneliness.Her difficult relationship with her co-worker increases her doubts about herself.Sonja (Karoline Herfurth) and Milan (Friedrich Mücke) go to family therapy.When it comes to light that the man has a new partner, the woman starts dating.

programme.title: Eddie the Eagle
programme.desc: British ski jumper Michael 'Eddie' Edwards, although not successful, believes in his abilities.Thanks to the help of a charismatic coach, in 1988 he took part in the Olympics in Calgary.

credits.actor: Richmond the BOA Official - Mark Benton

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Early 1970s, Colorado Springs, Colorado.Ron Stallworth (John David Washington) becomes the first black police officer in the department.After encountering manifestations of racism, he asks to be transferred to undercover work.He decides to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan, but for this he will need the help of an older, white colleague - Flip Zimmerman (Adam Driver).Ron calls representatives of a racist militia on the phone, and Flip meets with them directly.The police obtain information about the Klan's planned attack.Ron contacts David Duke (Topher Grace), the Grand Wizard of the Ku Klux Klan, by phone.Soon, Flip is accepted into the organization.Spike Lee's film won an Oscar for best adapted screenplay in 2019.Starring: versatile supporting actor Adam Driver ("What's Up, Davis?", "Silence") and former American football player John David Washington, Denzel Washington's son, nominated for a Golden Globe for this role.

credits.actor: Master Patrolman Andy Landers - Frederick Weller

programme.title: Druk
programme.desc: Denmark.Martin, Tommy, Peter and Nikolaj work as middle school teachers.They are burnt out and everyday life is taking its toll on them.During Nikolaj's birthday party, the men discuss the theory that humans are born with an alcohol deficit.Its small dose - only half a per mille in the blood - is supposed to increase their overall satisfaction.They decide to test it themselves and be excited every day.They quickly notice the positive effects - their family relationships improve, and they start to do better at work.Martin is finally able to communicate with his wife Anika and children, and the students finally listen to him with interest.Over time, however, it turns out that the initial dose is no longer enough for my friends and they start increasing it.They find that everything has its price.

programme.title: Forgetting Sarah Marshall
programme.desc: Los Angeles.Peter Bretter is a musician.His compositions can be heard in many television productions.However, the man's real dream is to stage a puppet musical about Count Dracula, who is looking for true love.He has been living in a happy relationship with actress Sarah Marshall for six years.Peter loves the girl completely and doesn't seem to notice her flaws.And Sarah has too many of them.As the star of a popular crime series, he makes himself felt by those around him with his selfishness, lack of respect for the feelings of others and the expectation of constant adoration.One day, Bretter is abandoned by his beloved.Devastated and hurt, he cannot regain his balance for many weeks.Finally, on the advice of his brother Brian, he decides to go on vacation to a resort in Hawaii.There he hopes to recover from unhappy love.Unfortunately, on arrival he is horrified to discover that Sarah and her new partner, rocker Aldous Snow, have rented a room in the same hotel.Meanwhile, a suffering Peter attracts the attention of attractive receptionist Rachel Jansen.The woman decides to help him.

programme.title: Queer
programme.desc: Year 1950, Mexico.William Lee (Daniel Craig), a middle-aged American, spends his days almost alone.He contacts several people from a small American community of students and bar owners.The arrival of another student, Eugene Allerton (Drew Starkey), in town makes him realize for the first time that an intimate bond is possible.The men first become friends, then their relationship turns into a romance.As a couple, they go to South America in search of a drug that supposedly gives the power of telepathy.

programme.title: Bird
programme.desc: 12-year-old Bailey (Nykiya Adams), her brother Hunter (Jason Buda) and her dad Bug (Barry Keoghan) live illegally in an abandoned building.The father doesn't have much time for the children.He is busy preparing for the wedding with his stepmother, whom they dislike, and looking for easy money.The mother became involved with an aggressive partner.Bailey also finds no support among her peers and becomes increasingly alienated.Her love for birds is her salvation.The girl spends more and more time alone in nature.One day she meets a tramp, Bird (Franz Rogowski), who asks her for help... Behind the camera, Andrea Arnold, director of "Fish Tank" and "American Honey" and the documentary "Cow".

programme.title: This Is Benjamin Ingrosso: Part 1
programme.desc: The story of the life of a Swedish singer.He was successful from an early age.She constantly develops her talent, striving to become the biggest pop star in Sweden.

programme.title: A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood
programme.desc: Lloyd Vogel (Matthew Rhys) is in crisis.His marriage to Andrea (Susan Kelechi Watson) is not going well.His son was recently born and he can't quite cope with the role of a parent.His wife, in turn, completely lost patience with his moods.He is also stressed by his relationship with his father, Jerry (Chris Cooper).She cannot forgive him for abandoning his family in the past and leaving him alone with his sick mother.Things aren't going well at work either.An aspiring investigative journalist is given a task by his superior that is below his skills.He is to prepare a short article as part of a series about inspiring people.He comes to interview the nationally beloved children's show host, Fred Rogers (Tom Hanks).Without any enthusiasm, he meets America's favorite, who immediately surprises him with his cheerfulness.Suddenly, the roles in their relationship are reversed.While it was Lloyd who was supposed to question Rogers, it was Rogers who steered the conversation and got him to confess.A friendship develops between the men.Under the influence of meetings with Fred, Vogel rediscovers the joy of life and begins to believe that he can repair relationships with his loved ones and experience happiness.A film inspired by a true story.

programme.title: Veep 5
programme.desc: The story of Vice President Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) continues, as she and her colleagues want to achieve something significant in politics.The woman avoids deals, scandals and corruption.She is assisted in her daily work by Amy, her office manager (Anna Chlumsky), spokesman Mike McLintock (Matt Walsh), general counsel Gary (Tony Hale) and secretary Sue (Sufe Bradshaw).When Selina Meyer unexpectedly takes over as president after her predecessor stepped down, the entire team must face a new challenge.

programme.title: Verano en diciembre
programme.desc: Four generations of women meet in Madrid at a convention organized by Teresa.She is accompanied by four daughters in their thirties, a granddaughter and her 95-year-old mother-in-law, who suffers from dementia.

programme.title: Soul On Fire
programme.desc: Nine-year-old John O'Leary suffers burns to almost his entire body.He struggles with pain and limitations.However, he wins love and makes his dreams come true.He inspires others by showing how to live life to the fullest.

programme.title: Doc Ii.
programme.desc: Dr. Amy Larsen, former chief of internal medicine, is rebuilding her life after a tragic accident that left her with no memory.Now she is an intern.Her past still haunts me.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
programme.desc: The Hobbit Frodo Baggins comes into possession of a magical Ring.His relative Bilbo obtained it during his expedition to the Lonely Mountain.This extraordinary gem can give its owner control over the world, which is why its creator - the Lord of Darkness Sauron - will do anything to get it back.The wizard Gandalf knows that the Ring must be destroyed.There is only one way to do this - by throwing him into the fire that burns inside Mount Doom.However, getting there is very difficult.A council is called in Rivendell on this matter.Frodo undertakes a dangerous mission to destroy the jewel.He is accompanied by his friendly hobbits, Sam Gamgee and Pippin and Merry, as well as representatives of other races: the elf Legolas, the dwarf Gimli, people - Aragorn and Boromir - and Gandalf.The ring has a sinister power that is difficult to avoid.It arouses strong desire and influences the psyche, which puts the team to the test.Meanwhile, Sauron sends his troops against her.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Doug (Jack Black) and Griff (Paul Rudd) have been friends since childhood.They have always dreamed of making a remake of their favorite film, the horror film "Anaconda".When both buddies experience a midlife crisis, they decide not to wait any longer and set off together deep into the Amazon to start filming.The situation becomes more complicated when... a real giant anaconda appears on the film set, spreading chaos and destruction around.Despite the deadly threat, the friends decide to take advantage of the predator's presence.

programme.title: Good Guy With A Gun
programme.desc: After the violent death of his father, teenage Will (Beck Nolan) and his mother, Tessa Greenwood (Tiffany Bedwell), move to a small town in Illinois.There is a house they inherited from an ancestor, which the woman intends to sell.There, Will meets boys his own age and quickly becomes friends with them.The new friends are fascinated by the weapons each of them has and spend time practicing their shooting skills.Will begins to share their passion, which even worsens his already not good relationship with his mother, complicates the mourning for his father, and even puts the boy's life in danger.

programme.title: Half Man
programme.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programme.desc: Laurie Saltair (Isabelle Fuhrman) arrives for the night shift at her family's remote warehouse with cubicles for rent.She's alone there.At one point, she is visited by a man who introduces himself as Benjamin Salgado (Don Johnson).Despite the late hour, he wants to go to room 234. Laurie asks him to leave, and when he looks into the stall, he is horrified to find a man inside, Clayton (Jack Huston), who has been chained to a stretcher and is about to become an organ donor.It soon turns out that Salgado is not alone, but that they are leading a group of people, ready to do anything to take the kidnapped person with them.Laurie must fight for his life, but also for her own.

programme.title: Guy Ritchie's the Covenant
programme.desc: March 2018.There is a war in Afghanistan.Master Sergeant John Kinley (Jake Gyllenhaal) and his unit are ambushed by the Taliban during a routine vehicle inspection.The American translator dies in it.He will be replaced by Ahmed Abdullah (Dar Salim).During a secret mission, Kinley learns that his new associate had previous ties to the Taliban.He escaped when the organization murdered his son.Over time, an alliance develops between him and the American soldier.Ahmed saves John, who after some time gains the opportunity to repay his debt.

programme.desc: Rock star Dewey Cox (John C. Reilly) seems to have done it all.The musician sold millions of records, won the hearts of hundreds of women, and his friends included such giants as Elvis and members of The Beatles.The artist's life consists primarily of performances in front of the audience and crazy, alcohol-infused parties.Cox does not shy away from various types of stimulants, and he cannot stay in a relationship with one woman for long.However, the most important thing for him is music, thanks to which he turned from a simple boy from the province into one of the world's greatest rock icons.Twice nominated for the Golden Globe (Best Actor and Best Original Song), a crazy parody of films about famous musicians inspired by the biographies of such musical personalities as Johnny Cash and Roy Orbison.

programme.title: Widow Clicquot

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.desc: The crazy scientist, Doctor Rex Vector, and his hamster assistant, Mister Pete, return to Pine Tree Mountain with Vector's new, evil invention: a robo-monster complete with animal abilities. But first, Vector needs to collect these skills. He comes up with a power absorbing gadget, which he often disguises, in order to trap and steal abilities from the innocent animals. Vick, Briar and Bramble, along with other animal friends, must stand up against this “monster plan” of Vector's. It's going to be a fierce fight between wild animals and poaching villains.

programme.title: Fury Spinner

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the region’s species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the city’s shrinking wetlands.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, everything has a place in nature’s great scheme. Complex interactions between species are not even limited to animals, and some of the best examples occur in the lush mountain forests of Africa.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africa’s amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed for thousands of years, evolving in different ways to a life aquatic.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It’s a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger shark’s most elusive behaviour: mating.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of Australia’s shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

programme.title: At Close Range

programme.title: Bandits

programme.title: Kalifornia

programme.title: The Great Train Robbery

programme.title: Red Dawn

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it.

programme.title: The Wild Sides
programme.desc: The creators of the three-part series follow the fate of several families of wild animals living in the Mashatu reserve in Botswana.The production was created over two years and presents the fate of four species.Around the bed of the dried river there are a pride of lions, elephants, a leopard, jackals with offspring, and playful baboons.Every day, these creatures fight to survive and raise their offspring in difficult conditions, and their fates are inextricably linked.Macquele the leopard is a single mother who must deal with the presence of hyenas, lions and jackals, as well as a troop of baboons giving her away her position every time she hunts.A herd of elephants led by Ukwethemba searches for food and water, covering long distances.For the young Abancane elephant, life on the move is not easy.Jackals are monogamous.The male and female of this species raise their offspring together.To find food for them, they must face much larger predators.Baboons are smart, cunning and cause trouble wherever they go.Among them are Umusa and her son The creators of the three-part documentary follow the adventures of the inhabitants of the Mashatu reserve in Botswana, which is a wildlife enclave.The heroes of this action-packed story are families of leopards, elephants, jackals and baboons.They lead different lifestyles and have different survival strategies, but their fates are closely intertwined.The cameras captured scenes of carefree play of the young ones, as well as tense moments when the animals' lives were at stake.For two years, the filmmakers observed the challenges posed to the fauna by the extreme weather conditions prevailing in this part of Africa.Survive the drought The first part of the documentary story focuses on the fight for survival while waiting for rain.One of the heroines is Macquele the leopard, who raises her daughter alone.The problem for her is not only the lack of water and food, but also the threat from hyenas, lions and jackals.Drought is also deadly for elephants, which are said to have no natural enemies in the animal world.However, they use their own methods to reach the water.Thanks to them, other species also increase their chance of survival.The filmmakers also observe conflicts in a troop of baboons.It turns out that these smart and cunning monkeys often get themselves into trouble.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The Savute region, which is located in Botswana, can be both a benevolent paradise and an extremely brutal hell for animals.However, it will always be unpredictable.Covering an area of ​​three thousand square miles, the African savannah is home to competing clans of predators.The survival of lions, leopards, hyenas and wild deer depends on huge herds of their potential prey - buffaloes, elephants and zebras.Every day means a fight for survival, in which the law of nature is the most important.The series has six episodes, thanks to which viewers will be transported to the extraordinary world of animals.There, death can come without warning.Even the most powerful and seemingly invincible kings of the savannah do not know when their last day will come.Viewers will also see how changing weather conditions affect the carnivore clans.During the rainy season, young are born, drought means less food and a dramatic struggle for survival.

programme.title: Into The Okavango
programme.desc: The Okavango Basin is a source of life-giving water for approximately one million people.Animals also draw from this spring - the world's largest population of African elephants, herds of lions, cheetahs and birds.However, this idyllic land is under threat due to human activities.The film is a documentary record of an expedition whose participants try to save the river system that feeds one of the last wild and naturally beautiful corners of the Earth - the Okavango Delta.The four-month expedition led through three countries, and the researchers defending this area covered nearly 2.5 thousand kilometers.km.

programme.title: Predator Fails
programme.desc: Lions, panthers and other predators arouse admiration as reliable hunters.However, hunting down prey requires a lot of effort from them.Very often, their search for prey ends in failure, which means hunger.Viewers will see how the most famous hunters in the animal world cope.They will learn how strength, speed, strategy and teamwork make predators successful in chasing, fighting and killing.They will see the difference between ocean hunters and forest hunters and savannah kings.The creators of the series show how poisonous venom, sharp claws and huge mouths are used.They also present survival strategies for potential victims, who often manage to escape the predator.

programme.title: America The Beautiful: Wild South West
programme.sub-title: On the edge of the desert
programme.desc: There is a 146-kilometer area between California's Death Valley and Mount Whitney, the highest peak in California.The authors of the program travel through deserts, mountains and wetlands with their cameras.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, a filmmaker and knowledge popularizer from Australia, begins his expedition through the most difficult corners of this continent.During the journey, he talks about animals that managed to master the art of survival.Each episode introduces three species and discusses their unique characteristics.From harsh deserts to seas to forests to rivers, Phil introduces viewers to a variety of ecosystems, showing which animals are best adapted to challenging environmental conditions Phil Breslin, born in Australia, has been talking with passion and enthusiasm for years about the nature of Kangaroo Land, which stands out from all other continents.It is inhabited by animal species that cannot be found in other parts of the world.There are extreme conditions in the antipodes, which forced the inhabitants to develop unique adaptation strategies.Divided into several parts, the document presents masters of survival in various habitats - in rainforests, deserts, swamps, as well as on the coast and in the ocean.Antipodes teeming with life. The naturalist begins his expedition in the hot and humid Australian rainforest.Among the lush tree crowns, you have the chance to spot a tree hawk with its young, as well as the largest snake in Australia - an amethyst python.He observes with delight the colorful cassowary - one of the most dangerous birds in the world.During his further escapade, he encounters more animals that arouse respect.While crossing the swamps, he has a chance to take a closer look at the massive saltwater crocodile, which is one of the most dangerous predators.The rocky coastlines are the kingdom of the white-bellied piscifer - a bird from the Accipitridae family, which boasts impressive talons.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: In this eerie, existential western directed by Monte Hellman and written by Carole Eastman (Five Easy Pieces), Warren Oates and Will Hutchins play a bounty hunter and his sidekick who are talked by a mysterious woman (Millie Perkins) into leading her into the desert on a murkily motivated revenge mission. Things are further complicated by the addition to their crew of an enigmatic drifter (Jack Nicholson) who seems to delight in sadistically toying with the two men. Hellman’s singular odyssey is a vision of the weird old west unlike any other, a spare and challenging work leading to a provocative ending.

In 2011, mankind learns the truth the hard way when alien invaders attack. One by one, the world's great cities fall, leaving Los Angeles as the battleground for humanity's last stand. It's up to a Marine staff sergeant (Aaron Eckhart) and his platoon to draw a line in the sand against a powerful enemy unlike any previously encountered.

programme.title: The Chi
programme.desc: The South Side of Chicago carries daily danger, and the smallest and simplest of decisions can have life or death consequences for the residents. Life continues as the kids prep for school and their parents shuffle off to work. The young adults of the area are trying to scrape a living for themselves, while the elders sit on their front porches and observe the goings on. The South Side has the potential to crush dreams, and this coming-of-age series focuses on Kevin, a preteen who embraces the normal rites of childhood, Brandon, who makes a leap of faith to succeed in love and life with Jerrika, Emmett, who seeks guidance from his mother, and Ronnie, who is a drifter struggling to be loved. All of them are linked together by sheer coincidence as they seek redemption.

programme.title: Couples Therapy
programme.desc: "Couples Therapy" is a documentary series following couples as they seek the help of psychoanalyst Dr. Orna Guralnik with their troubled relationships; coming off their previous success with the award-winning documentary "Weiner", executive producers Josh Kriegman and Elyse Steinberg are collaborating on the unscripted series that will feature real couples from New York City and its surrounding areas; the show strives to present the participants and the therapy process with empathy and not sensationalism as viewers track the couples' progress with Dr. Guralnik through each episode.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: When Jerry is booked to appear on "The Tonight Show With Jay Leno," he takes George with him to Los Angeles to search for Kramer -- who vanished in a huff months earlier only to pop up inexplicably on TV in an episode of "Murphy Brown." George and Jerry are unaware that their wayward friend is in trouble as a victim of mistaken identity. Meanwhile, George bothers every celebrity he encounters.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: While searching for Kramer in Los Angeles, Jerry and George are picked up for questioning by the police, who suspect Kramer is a notorious serial killer known as the smog stranger.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: A comedy of errors kicks in when Jerry is frustrated in his attempts to squeeze in two comedy appearances on opposite sides of town while shadowed by a pesky fellow comedian. Later, Jerry's bad timing continues when he has to rendezvous for a movie with George, Elaine and Kramer -- who are all in different orbits looking for seats as well as each other.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: When an eavesdropping college reporter mistakenly prints that Jerry and his pal George are intimate longtime companions, Jerry vainly works overtime to prove his straightness. And when the big-city newspapers pick up the story, Jerry has a lot of explaining to do to his overwrought parents.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Good Samaritans Jerry, George and Elaine volunteer to comfort and assist senior citizens in their homes. programme.title: Seinfeld

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry and George narrowly avoid a public stoning after George parks his father's car in a handicapped spot -- inciting an angry mob to trash the vehicle when a disabled woman is injured as a result of the illegal parking. programme.title: Naked and Afraid 5
programme.desc: Two unknown people, a woman and a man, are left in a lonely place with difficult climatic conditions.They must spend 21 days there without food, water or clothing.They can only take one item with them.The operators show how daredevils, relying on their own company, learn to cooperate and make key decisions together.Viewers will see that appropriate knowledge and skills can be very useful in extreme moments and even determine survival.

programme.title: Africa Express
programme.desc: For the first time, the race will take participants through Africa.They will cover the route through Kenya and Tanzania - from the foot of Kilimanjaro, through the crowded streets of Arusha, to the sand dunes by the Indian Ocean and historic Mombasa, ending the competition in Nairobi.Eight couples: Ewa Gawryluk-Domaniecka with her husband Piotr Domaniecki, Edyta Zając with her partner Michał Mikołajczak, Nikodem Rozbicki with her friend Paweł Kurkowski, Wiktoria Gąsiewska with her brother Mateusz Gąsiewski, Tomasz Iwan with her partner Karolina Woźniak, Katarzyna Niezgoda with her husband Paweł Markiewicz, Izu Ugonoh with his wife Antonina Ugonoh and MonikaHoffman-Piszora, together with her sister Iga Hoffman, faces the challenges of harsh, unpredictable nature - lack of roads, difficult access to water and communication, time pressure and their own emotions.The program will be hosted by Iza Krzan.Every day, participants must demonstrate perseverance, cooperation and resilience, learning about completely different faces of Africa.It's a test of boundaries and a lesson in friendship Participants move from the lands of Tsavo to the majestic Great Rift Valley, where the expedition gains new dynamics.The couple who left the race are given a chance to return, but must remain hidden, traveling without luggage or support.If exposed, they will face elimination.The others face the task of estimating the length of the longest continental trench, fighting for the advantage on the further route to Naivasha, the center of the Kenyan flower industry.There, couples prepare symbolic bouquets to order, testing their floral talents.Fighting for the amulet is Kati's dynamic game, reminiscent of dodgeball.In Nairobi, competitors immerse themselves in the world of colorful matatu minibuses.They must find their driver, learn to dance and engage passengers in having fun together.The finale reveals the secret of the return of the eliminated couple.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: In Bulgaria, Martyna visits a traditional family belonging to the small Kalajj ethnic group.Only 18,000 of them live in the country.The Kalajjs care very much about the purity of the group, and they arrange marriages only between their own kin.The young people get to know each other and observe each other for years, and if a bachelor catches the eye of a girl, negotiations begin.Every year, everyone comes to the area of ​​Stara Zagora on Saint Theodore's Day.Martyna meets 19-year-old Vasylka.The girl will present herself at this year's virgin market.The traveler accompanies her in preparations, during which they choose a dress and bake a traditional cake.He also learns about the amazing customs of the Kalajj people, their financial negotiations and the type of test that is supposed to prove that the bride has actually remained chaste until her wedding night.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: The World Health Organization estimates that there are approximately 170,000 people with vitiligo in Tanzania.Albinos are very susceptible to burns and skin cancer.Many of them die before the age of 40.The threat is not only from the harsh African sun, but also from other people.In Tanzania, it is common to believe that the body of an albino has magical powers.Hunting of them is becoming more and more common.Martyna visits a school where a hundred children suffering from vitiligo study.He also meets 19-year-old Kabula.A girl aged 12 was brutally attacked.After the incident, she is determined to become a lawyer and defend the rights of people affected by albinism in the future.Together with Martyna, they will visit her parents, whom she has not seen for 5 years.Previously, the girl did not have the courage to come home.

programme.title: Along Came the Devil
programme.desc: Growing up wasn't easy for Ashley, and in her quest for belonging, she accidentally welcomes an evil presence, leaving her family and friends in a desperate battle to save her.

programme.title: Deadly Inferno
programme.desc: During some extensive renovations on an eight-storey office building, a major gas leak leads to a terrible explosion, trapping the injured staff in a fiery maze. Can the brave firefighters provide a safe exit from this deadly inferno?

programme.title: A Wizard's Tale
programme.desc: From the writer of Ice Age: The Meltdown and with a stellar voice cast, including Ian McShane (John Wick, Coraline), Lily Collins (Mirror Mirror) and Toby Kebbell (Ben-Hur, Warcraft), A WIZARD’S TALE is an uplifting magical journey that is guaranteed to cast its spell on adults and children alike. A WIZARD’S TALE is a magical family adventure about one boy’s quest to restore happiness to the world after an evil wizard named “The Grump” casts an evil spell on a formerly happy land. Join Terry on his adventure, as he outwits a multitude of weird and wonderful creatures and finds friendship with Princess Dawn along the way. A.k.a. Here Comes the Grump

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: In this whimsical animated adventure, a mermaid princess makes a deal with a sea witch to transform into a human.

programme.title: A Stork's Journey
programme.desc: Richard is a sparrow. Orphaned at birth and raised by storks, he believes that he is a stork, too! But when winter comes and his adoptive flock prepare to migrate to Africa, his true identity is revealed and his family must leave him behind in the forest with the other sparrows. Determined to prove he is a stork after all, Richard ventures south on an epic adventure, accompanied by friends big and small, to unleash his true potential and be reunited with his family.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: Quirt Evans, an all round bad guy, is nursed back to health and sought after by Penelope Worth, a Quaker girl. He eventually finds himself having to choose between his world and the world Penelope lives in.

programme.title: Zorro
programme.desc: In the New World, a new Spanish governor finds the province of Nueva Aragón under the iron fist of the corrupt Colonel Huerta and vows to bring justice under the guise of a masked avenger.

programme.title: Asteroid: Final Impact
programme.desc: As the Earth is on a collision course with a deadly asteroid after a small-scale meteor shower, a discredited astrophysicist and his team race against time to hack into a state-of-the-art meteor-tracking satellite. Can he save the world?

programme.title: Gorgo
programme.desc: The classic sci-fi story of a captured baby prehistoric monster put on display in London, with giant momma monster coming to the rescue!

programme.title: The People That Time Forgot
programme.desc: In 1919, a British expedition in the Antarctica region is searching for a lost American explorer and finds a hidden prehistoric world instead.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page Conners are a mother-and-daughter con team. Their cunning plan? Max singles out a wealthy man and convinces him to marry her. Once married, Page seduces the unsuspecting groom whilst ensuring Max catches them in the an uncompromising position. Cue divorce proceedings and a large settlement. What could possibly go wrong, except maybe falling in love?

programme.title: Iron Men
programme.desc: Checking out the West Ham United journey as they relocate after over a century at Upton Park. Fans and behind-the-scenes moments capture this big move to their new stadium.

programme.title: The Walking Deceased
programme.desc: When a police officer wakes up in a hospital to find out he is in the middle of a zombie apocalypse, he will do anything to find his family, even sacrifice Twitter. The Walking Deceased is an hilarious spoof of The Walking Dead is about to spread. The story follows a group of survivors from all walks of the apocalypse - an idiotic Sheriff, his belligerent son, four squabbling friends, and a lonely zombie. They all leave their safe hideouts in search of the Safe Haven Ranch, a refuge untouched by the zombie virus.

programme.title: A Patch of Fog
programme.desc: A security guard catches a famous writer/television host shoplifting and blackmails him into becoming friends. He then uses that friendship and the eve of the anniversary of the publication of his most successful novel to manipulate him further.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Shortly after coming to terms with his daughter's marriage, a father faces the prospect of becoming a grandfather.

programme.title: Mothers Of The Bride
programme.desc: Jenna is getting married, her mother is delighted until Jenna announces she wants to find her birth mother.
